title: THE TITLE KEY LINE NAMES F1 FOR THE CONTROLS LIST
why: UI step 30, menu map. The title key line said H controls. Since keyswap H is the quick heal and F1 shows the controls, so a party guest who read the title and pressed H healed instead of seeing the controls. It says F1 now. Nothing else changed.
now: The title key line now says F1 controls, the key that really opens the list (H heals).

edits.replacement: F1 controls
